get.description:
Return a list of all Work Order Contracts of a specified Project.

See [Filtering on List Actions](https://developers.procore.com/documentation/filtering-on-list-actions) for information on using the filtering capabilities provided by this endpoint.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Specifies how much information to show for each work order contract. The compact view is returned by default.

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified IDs.

parameters.name: filters[status]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified Work Order Contract status.

parameters.name: filters[created_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) created within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00` - Datetime with Custom Offset

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) last updated within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00` - Datetime with Custom Offset

parameters.name: filters[include_deleted]
parameters.description: Use 'only' for only deleted resources. Use 'with' for deleted and undeleted resources.

parameters.name: filters[origin_id]
parameters.description: Origin ID. Returns item(s) with the specified Origin ID.

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

draft_change_orders_amount.description: Total of all draft change orders

private.description: If true, visible to admins and whitelisted accessors; otherwise visible to those with read only access.

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

headers = { 'Authorization': "Bearer REPLACE_BEARER_TOKEN" }

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/work_order_contracts?project_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&view=SOME_STRING_VALUE&page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&filters%5Bid%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bstatus%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Bcreated_at%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Bupdated_at%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Binclude_deleted%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Borigin_id%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE", headers=headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

custom_field_%{custom_field_definition_i.description:
Value of the custom field. The data type of the value passed in corresponds with the data_type of the Custom Field Definition.
For a lov_entry data_type the value passed in should be the ID of one of the Custom Field Definition's LOV Entries. For a lov_entries data_type the value passed in should be an array of IDs of the Custom Field Definition's LOV Entries.

get.description:
Return a Work Order Contract.

### Special notes (Tiers)

The visibility of Change Order Packages, Potential Change Orders & Change Order Requests
depends on the number of tiers defined in the Work Order Contract as follows:

1-tier: Change Order Packages

2-tier: Change Order Packages, Potential Change Orders

3-tier: Change Order Packages, Change Order Requests, Potential Change Orders
